tasks.short: Sign overhaul documents for replaced or repaired equipment.

steps.what: Read the mail asking for overhaul documents to be signed.
Open the work order for the replaced equipment.
Read serial and test result on the repaired equipment.
Read stored parts and hours for the overhaul.
Draft overhaul documents from stored parts and hours.
Check overhaul documents against the repaired equipment.
Sign the accepted overhaul documents for the equipment.

tasks.design: The {OTHER} maintenance record drafts overhaul documents from the stored asset, serial, parts, hours, and test result, and stops there. The repairer checks that draft against the equipment in hand. {ESIGN} signs only the accepted version and does not change it.
tasks.previous_blocker: The overhaul document was typed after the repair, so a signature could land on wording that was still changing.
tasks.enabler_now: The maintenance record already stores the asset, serial, parts, hours, and test result, so a document can be assembled and held unsigned.
tasks.still_hard: Only the repairer can judge that the document matches the equipment, and only that person can sign.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer sees the replaced parts and the test on the equipment and decides the document is true before signing.
tasks.altitude: Less time typing overhaul documents from the work order. The same time on the equipment and on the signature. No new decision right.

reach.task: Sign the repair record for machinery they have replaced or repaired.
reach.learn: Which stored fields must be present before a signature is offered, and when a mismatch sends the record back.

evidence.claim: An overhaul document can be assembled from asset, serial, parts, hours, and test result already stored on the work order, and held unsigned until a person signs. Model knowledge.
FieldBuddy completes a work order from the job and keeps a technician checklist.
AMOS Production stores a completed work order and applies an integrated electronic signature.
Workflow systems that track staff, and computers that track a van, need works-council consent before use.
Annex III point 4(b) treats as high-risk an AI system that allocates work from individual behaviour or traits, or that monitors performance.

assumptions: The work order already stores asset id, serial, parts used, labour hours, and the test result, written when the repair was recorded. This task does not create that work order. If one of those fields is missing, the draft does not run.
The prior time on a separate tally is folded into the maintenance-system screens, because parts and hours are fields on the work order.
The check compares the draft with the equipment and does not edit it. A mismatch goes back to the stored fields. The signature binds accepted overhaul document v1 and does not change that wording.
The signed record stays on the company asset. No copy is sent outside in this task.

No focal upkeep is added. Exceptions stay in the check, which keeps its full time. The maintenance system does not allocate jobs and does not score the repairer. It records who signed the asset record and does not track the van. Works-council consent is still in the build because that signature log can be read as staff tracking.
unknowns: Whether this site's overhaul document is also handed to the customer, or stays on the internal asset record.
Whether national rules name a certifying person other than the repairer who did the work.
Whether the works council has already consented to the maintenance system logging sign times.
research_questions: Which fields the current overhaul document requires beyond asset, serial, parts, hours, and test result.
Who may sign when the repairer is not the authorised person for that equipment.

already_counted.description: Comparing the draft with the serial, parts, and test seen on the equipment.

incremental.description: Keep the map from work-order fields to the overhaul document current when the form changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is zero when parts, hours, or the test result are missing, so no document is drafted. High is 12 when those fields are present and some drafts are sent back because they do not match the equipment. The look at the equipment and the signature stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less time typing overhaul documents from the work order. The same time on the equipment and on the signature. No new decision right.
skills_to_grow: Reading the test result and the replaced parts onto the work order before a document is drafted.
Refusing the signature when the stored parts do not match the equipment.
role.ambitious_version: The repairer signs only when the stored test matches the equipment, and the same check is offered to machinery mechanics who sign their own repair records.

job.title: Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Commercial and Industrial Equipment
